chapters.label: Wembley, 2024
chapters.text: Wembley, 2024. England against Brazil, ten minutes to go. A long ball sends Vinícius Júnior clear. Jordan Pickford saves... but seventeen-year-old Endrick taps it in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Vinícius races through and shoots. The keeper blocks it, but look who is following in.

chapters.label: In the right place
chapters.text: Endrick is in the right place. The ball drops right at his feet, and he taps it home. Brazil win, one–nil!

chapters.label: Be ready
chapters.text: Always follow a shot in. Be ready near goal: a quick finish gives the keeper no time to get up.
